memories.content: Nine households on Alder Court have said they are in for setting up the water table. They have discussed it all month on the app. They have not yet set up the table as of the simulation start.

The Riverton marathon starts Sunday at 07:00. The first runners are expected to pass the corner of Alder Court (mile four) around 08:30. The city's runner guide lists their corner as mile four. The weather forecast is fine. The neighbors have a plan to set up a water table at that corner before the runners pass.
